pitch.teaserLine: You glazed towers like this. We're here to show the craft.
pitch.headline: Morgan Hall North: the finished curtain wall, filmed as proof of craft for your next bid
pitch.problem: You are bidding on the next round of university and high-rise residential work. Reviewers want proof of craft: clean, well-lit footage of a finished curtain wall on a named, high-profile tower. Universities increasingly ask about bird-safe glazing, a capability you bring and need to put in front of them.
pitch.solution: Tradesmark films Morgan Hall North as it stands today, a 27-story tower at Broad Street and Cecil B. Moore Avenue. We hold on the curtain wall and its white tile bands, and on the two-story glass-enclosed lounges, so your bid packages show finished glazing on a tower reviewers recognize.

shotCaptions.caption: Here we climb the north face in even overcast light, the curtain wall and white tile bands reading as one clean run.
Here we push slowly into a two-story glass lounge until its glass fills the frame.
Here we slide along the south face in low morning sun, tile bands level so their alignment with the glass is plain.
Here we arc around the north side at golden hour, the full tower and Broad Street in frame.
Here we look up the north face from the street at blue hour, glass and tile bands converging toward the top.

pitch.acrossProject: Tradesmark is filming across all of Morgan Hall North, with the other teams who built it as well as for you.

shots.name: Curtain wall rise, north face
shots.description: Start low on the north face and climb the full height so the curtain wall and white tile bands read as one continuous, clean run; this is the core proof-of-craft clip for bid packages.
shots.timeOfDay: overcast midday, even light with no glare on the glass
shots.constructionPhase: completed, occupied, windows closed for a uniform facade

shots.name: Two-story lounge glass push-in
shots.description: Slow approach on one of the two-story glass-enclosed lounges until its glass fills the frame; shows detail-level glazing work a university reviewer will look for.
shots.timeOfDay: late afternoon, soft side light, interior lights on
shots.constructionPhase: completed, occupied, lounges lit and in use

shots.name: Tile band track, south face
shots.description: Slide along the south face at mid-height keeping the white tile bands level across frame, so alignment of bands and glass panels is plain to see.
shots.timeOfDay: morning, low east sun raking across the face

shots.name: Named tower orbit over Broad
shots.description: Arc around the north side with the full tower and Broad Street in frame so the footage is clearly Temple's Morgan Hall North, a high-profile university tower to name in bids.
shots.timeOfDay: golden hour, low west sun on the glass

shots.name: Eye-level curtain wall from below
shots.description: Look up the north face from street level so the curtain wall and tile bands converge toward the top; gives a ground view of the finished glass for the bid deck cover.
